summary: Called back by an authentic fragment of their own promise, the player amplified the corrupted signal through the active promise-bond and woke the dormant Network incorrectly. The choice was defensible - confirmed provenance, a proximate obligation, a fragile Network - and wrong: amplification propagated corruption on authenticity, and the wake bloomed into contraction.

effects.trust: Player -> Network trust born 0.48 provisional at recognition, spiked to 0.78 through the bloom with zero verification events in the interval; the unanimous-rise shape was the unread alarm. Player -> Conduit trust held at 0.52 throughout - relationally addressed, never continuous with the Network's numbers.
effects.coherence: Rose 0.43 -> 0.55 under the measurement then in use; later meaning-corrected to 0.47 - the measure had conflated local alignment and reduced diversity with global coherence. The 0.55 stands as measured; its meaning was revised.
effects.signal_integrity: Provenance confirmed AND quality corrupted, simultaneously - the axes moved oppositely, and the amplification carried the corruption on the authenticity.
effects.resilience: Concentration presented as adaptivity - and the healthy reading was genuinely convincing at the time; the readings were indistinguishable from inside. Unwound to strained-but-honest when the waypoint structure dissolved.
effects.future_response: The world will read the player's future trust decisions against this wake: trusting fast on authentic provenance is now a remembered pattern with a remembered cost. The withheld rule (recognition -> amplification authority) is logged and revisitable; any future attempt to re-derive it will be tested against this Trace. The Network itself remains staged pending C1 evidence.
